operations.description: Instantly translate your content with your existing TM and MT resources. This is the primary endpoint to translate your files and content on the fly, especially in CI/CD environments. This is a complex endpoint that is configured in your Active or Continuous Project dashboards. For instance, you can configure whether to use your TM, or translate missing strings via MT and then post-edit those new translations. There are various scenarios you can establish via a set of configurations.
